# Media fixtures

One small file per format row of the media plan, generated by `scripts/media-fixtures.sh` from ffmpeg's own test sources
(`testsrc2` 320x180 at 25 fps, `sine` 440 Hz at 48 kHz stereo). Nothing third-party. Each file is at most 2 s and 300 KB.

`manifest.tsv` has 26 rows: `file kind codec expect sha256 ref`.

| expect | What `tests/fixtures_decode.rs` proves (by the shipped routes: feature `h264` only, switch OFF) |
| --- | --- |
| `play` | the helper opens it and the first 3 pictures match ffmpeg's decode (PSNR >= 45 dB on luma), or the first second of audio matches (lossless: s16 PCM hash equal; lossy: RMS within 1 %); `no_sound` is `None` |
| `silent` | the video plays (3 pictures, PSNR >= 45 dB), `audio` is `None` and `no_sound` names the audio codec it cannot play (AAC in `h264-aac.mkv` / `.ts`) |
| `system` | the codec's route is the system's decoder: `NoSystemDecoder(codec)` (AAC, E-AC-3, HEVC, and the H.264 streams FilmCraft cannot decode) |
| `unsupported` | the codec's route is off: `Unsupported(codec)` (MPEG-2, ProRes, AC-3) |
| `refuse` | the specific refusal, never a picture or PCM: MPEG-4 Part 2 `NoSystemDecoder(Mpeg4Part2)`, WMV2 and WMA `NoDecoder` (`refused_with`) |

There is no HEVC rust-route test: FilmCraft's HEVC decoder is never built into the helper (no feature, not in the
graph), so both HEVC rows are `system`.

`pcm.wav` is 1 s (2 s of 48 kHz stereo would be over the 300 KB cap). `he-aac.m4a` is not generated: no public static
ffmpeg encodes HE-AAC, so `committed/he-aac.m4a` is copied after its hash is checked (`committed/ORIGIN.md`).

`ref/<file>.y` (one per fixture, never shared) holds the Y planes of the first 3 frames as ffmpeg decodes them; the manifest's `ref` is their SHA-256.

## Regenerate

Needs ffmpeg with libx264, libx265, libvpx, libvpx-vp9, libaom-av1 or libsvtav1, mpeg2video, mpeg4, prores_ks, wmv2, wmav2,
libmp3lame, aac, flac, alac, libopus, libvorbis, pcm_s16le, ac3, eac3 (the BtbN static build has them all). The script
checks the list first and exits 3 naming the first encoder missing:

    scripts/media-fixtures.sh

It downloads nothing; without ffmpeg it exits 2 with "ffmpeg missing". Then run
`cargo test --locked --release --test fixtures_decode` in `native/beebeeb-media-helper`.
